name: Replays
state: In progress: PRs 1 to 4, 5a, 5b-1, the engineering-only boss rule, 5b-2 and 5b-3a merged (hidden replay features, replay extras and REPAIR removed; snapshot codecs in src/gameplay/snapshot; the detached world in src/app/world/detached; the record, recorder and verify, with the round-trip check over the determinism corpus; one seed type, one start record and one run start for live play and detached worlds, ruleset v21; replays refuse engineering-only bosses; reward picks and rerolls are actions and a held screen holds detached and headless worlds; scene frames are in the record and verify plays them); open: 5b-3b, the live replay tap and a browser gate that live campaign and Boss Rush runs verify from their seeds
